composition.serve_who: This sheet is a Termodinamica SW108-01 wiring schematic for the vessel's marine inverter air conditioning system. It documents two parallel VRV18E1 compressor/BUS networks (Port and Starboard) each feeding a chain of fan coil (MRMAXI18i/MRMAXI30i) units per cabin/zone, their thermostats, touch screen interfaces, a sea water pump per compressor, current sensors and TMD bridge modules. All labelled loads (VRV18E1, Sea Water Pump TMD100, MRMAXI fancoils per named cabin) map onto the 590-aircon-system family of nodes (compressor units 590-aircon-compressor-1/2 and per-cabin fancoil nodes). Shared BUS/Ethernet/switch-box wiring, cable specs, and switchboard breakers are infrastructure and are attached to the aircon system hub / DC distribution rather than any single fancoil.

equipment_groups.equipment_name: VRV18E1 Compressor Unit - Engine Room Port
equipment_groups.placement_reasoning: Sheet explicitly labels this block 'VRV18E1 ENGINE ROOM PORT', fed from Main Switchboard Port breaker B1 40A, and it drives the Port BUS Master Line and Sea Water Pump; matches Aircon Unit 1 node (compressor + heat exchanger + seawater cooling pump).

functions.label: Port compressor mains power supply
functions.what_it_does: Supplies 230VAC mains power to the Port compressor unit, which in turn powers its own Sea Water Pump and originates the Port BUS Master Line 1 to all Port fan coils.

flow_scenarios.path: Main Switchboard (Port) → Breaker B1 40A (C or D curve) → 3x6mm² L+N+PE cable → VRV18E1 Engine Room Port compressor terminal block

functions.dry_data: 230VAC, 3x6mm² L+N+PE, breaker B1 40A C/D curve; ground/anode wire kept independent per warranty warning.

functions.label: Port sea water cooling supply
functions.sheet_region: left-middle, red 'SEA WATER PUMP TMD100' circle below Port VRV18E1
functions.what_it_does: Provides seawater circulation power to cool the Port compressor's heat exchanger.

flow_scenarios.path: VRV18E1 Engine Room Port → 3x1.5mm² L+N+PE red cable → Sea Water Pump TMD100 (Port)

functions.label: Port BUS network origination

functions.what_it_does: Originates the Port BUS Master Line 1 (orange) that links the compressor to the Touch Screen Interface, fan coils, current sensor and TMD Bridge on the Port side, and connects via Switch BUS Box to the Starboard network.

flow_scenarios.path: VRV18E1 Engine Room Port → BUS Master Line 1 (orange, 2x2x0.75mm² <10m / 2x1x0.75+2x1.5mm² <20m / 2x1x0.75+2x2.5mm² 20-40m) → Touch Screen Interface Addr.1 → chain of Port fancoils → AC/DC Current Sensor Addr.31 → TMD Bridge Addr.32 → RS485 Modbus RTU → Switch BUS Box Connection (links to Stbd network)

functions.dry_data: BUS Master Line 1, twisted pair 100/120 ohm impedance, 50-60pF/m capacitance, shield connected to GND at compressor side only.

facts: Two Main Switchboards (Port & Stbd), each with Breaker B1 40A C/D curve feeding respective VRV18E1 units — mains distribution, not equipment-specific.
Internet Router feeds Ethernet lan to two 'Touch Screen 7' nodes (one per Port/Stbd system) via UTP Cat.5 cable.
Touch Screen Interface Addr.1 (TMD Internet Interface, 80W@24VDC) acts as network bridge/gateway per side, shared infrastructure for all fancoils on that side.

BUS Master Line 1 (orange) and BUS Slave Line (magenta) cable specifications: section 0.5–1.0mm², impedance 100/120 ohm, capacitance 50-60pF/m, twisted pair ~10 twists/m, shield grounded only at compressor box side.

Switch BUS Box Connection physically links Port and Stbd BUS networks together (shared distribution/rack element between the two VRV18E1 systems), containing internal terminal blocks/relay per detail inset.
AC/DC Current Sensor TRMS mod.QI-50-V-485 (Addr.31, Max 50A) and TMD Bridge (Addr.32) present on both Port and Stbd chains as network bridging/monitoring infrastructure feeding RS485 Modbus RTU.
Ground/anode wiring note: compressor ground wire must connect to an independent anode/zinc and never share with any other device; violation invalidates warranty.

Detail insets (right side) show internal wiring for: SyxthSense Touch Screen, VRV18E1 Terminal Block, SubSlave/Master Air Handler connections, TS7E 7" Exor Touch Screen & Dual Touch Screen Interfaces, AC/DC Current Sensor, and Switch BUS Box — these are wiring/connection details of the shared BUS infrastructure, not separate equipment.

uncertainties: No exact register node exists for 'Fwd Guest cabin' fancoil (Addr.2) or 'Owner's cabin' fancoil (Addr.11) among 590-aircon-fancoil-* entries; mapped to 590-aircon-fancoil-master as closest available placeholder — this may be incorrect and should be verified against the actual cabin layout.
FANCOIL NOTES box (top center) appears empty/blank on the sheet — no content to extract.
Exact wire gauge break-points for BUS Master/Slave lines depend on PCB count and cable length; all three tiers noted but not tied to a specific measured length on this sheet.

Six/nine detail insets on the right side are wiring-detail close-ups of the same BUS/Air Handler infrastructure already captured in the main schematic; not re-itemized as separate equipment functions to avoid duplication.
